mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 5.0% over the previous month signals an easing cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS is declining below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days, as lower unemployment signals labor market strength and economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing below 4.0% in the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) and retail sales (HOUST) above their 2007 averages signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 2007 averages.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100.0 triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days, reflecting stronger supply-side growth and reduced inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite INDPRO exceeding 100.0 in the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) above their 2007 averages creates a dual easing signal, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS falls and GDPC1 rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% amplifies labor market confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive despite UNRATE falling below 4.0% in the regime context.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing-related demand (HOUST) above 1409.0 triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days, indicating a strengthening housing market and broader economic momentum.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite HOUST exceeding 1409.0 in the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and a decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) below 5.0% creates a supply-easing environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO rises and FEDFUNDS falls concurrently.
